Increments the node counter this[22], stores the owner back-link at a2+80, runs a helper computation over four cached fields, then either initializes head/tail (this[18], this[20]) when the list is empty or walks the +72 next-pointers from FieldGetter_8e30(this) to append a2 at the tail.

Run the insertion-side computation ShortComputation_a9c0(this[1], this[2], this[3], this[4]) using four cached fields.
v3 = FieldGetter_8e30(this): retrieve the current list head.
If v3 is nonzero the list already contains at least one node.
Walk the +72 next pointers from the head to the last node: for (i = *(v3 + 72); i; i = *(i + 72)) v3 = i.
Append a2 as the successor of the last node: *(_DWORD *)(v3 + 72) = a2.
Return a2 as the inserted node.
If FieldGetter_8e30 returned zero the list is empty: initialize head and tail to a2.
Set head this[18] = a2 and tail this[20] = a2.
Return a2 as the inserted node.
